title: OPEC+ core members hold December output targets steady; Saudi level stays near 10.48 million bpd
detail: Seven core OPEC+ members kept December production targets unchanged for a third month, at about 31 million bpd combined. Reuters-based reporting puts Saudi Arabia's allocation at about 10.478 million bpd, the largest in the group. Most members are producing below target because of regional war disruption.
